'''Pietro Corvaja''' (born 19 July 1967 in [[Padua]], [[Italy]])<ref name="Instituto-Veneto">{{cite web |url=http://www.istitutoveneto.it/flex/FixedPages/Common/accademici.php/L/IT/IDS/387 |title=Pietro Corvaja |publisher=[[Istituto Veneto di Scienze, Lettere ed Arti]] |accessdate=13 January 2020 |lang=it}}</ref> is an Italian mathematician working in [[Diophantine geometry]]. He is a professor of geometry at the [[University of Udine]].<ref name="Udine-Math">{{cite web |url=https://www.dmif.uniud.it/persone/pietro.corvaja/ |publisher=[[University of Udine]], Dipartimento di Scienze, Matematiche Informatiche e fisiche |title=Pietro Corvaja |lang=it |accessdate=13 January 2020}}</ref><ref name="Udine">{{cite web |url=https://people.uniud.it/page/pietro.corvaja |publisher=[[University of Udine]] |title=Pietro Corvaja |lang=it |accessdate=13 January 2020}}</ref>

==Early life and education==
Corvaja was born in Padua, Italy on 19 July 1967.<ref name="Instituto-Veneto"/> He graduated with a scientific high school diploma from a [[liceo scientifico]] in 1985,<ref name="Instituto-Veneto"/> before enrolling in the [[University of Pisa]] as a student of the [[Scuola Normale Superiore di Pisa]].<ref name="Instituto-Veneto"/> He graduated from the Scuola Normale with an undergraduate thesis on the theory of [[transcendental number]]s under the direction of Roberto Dvornicich in 1989.<ref name="Instituto-Veneto"/><ref name="ORCID">{{ORCID|0000-0001-8762-4163}}</ref>

After a one year scholarship at [[Istituto Nazionale di Alta Matematica Francesco Severi|INdAM]] from 1989 to 1990, Corvaja completed his PhD under [[Michel Waldschmidt]] and Michel Laurent at [[Pierre and Marie Curie University]] in 1995.<ref name="MathGenealogy">{{MathGenealogy|id=73976}}</ref><ref name="Instituto-Veneto"/> From 1994 to 1995, he was also a research assistant at the [[Università Iuav di Venezia]] as a collaborator of [[Umberto Zannier]].<ref name="Instituto-Veneto"/> In 2001, Corvaja obtained his [[habilitation]] qualification at Pierre and Marie Curie University.<ref name="Instituto-Veneto"/>

==Career==
In 1995, Corvaja became a researcher at the University of Udine.<ref name="Instituto-Veneto"/> From 1997 to 1998, he was a member of the [[Institute for Advanced Study]] under the direction of [[Enrico Bombieri]].<ref name="IAS-profile">{{cite web |url=https://www.ias.edu/scholars/pietro-corvaja |title=Pietro Corvaja |publisher=[[Institute for Advanced Study]] |accessdate=13 January 2020}}</ref><ref name="Instituto-Veneto"/> In 2002, Corvaja became an associate professor of algebra at the University of Udine.<ref name="Instituto-Veneto"/> Since 2005, he has been a professor of geometry at the University of Udine.<ref name="Instituto-Veneto"/><ref name="ORCID"/>

Corvaja is the coordinator of the mathematics program and the vice director of the [[Superior Graduate Schools in Italy|Scuola Superiore (School of Excellence)]] of the University of Udine.<ref name="controcampus">{{cite news|url=https://www.controcampus.it/2014/05/universita-udine-porte-aperte-future-matricole/ |lang=it |title=Università di Udine: porte aperte alla future matricole |trans-title=University of Udine: doors open to future freshmen |publisher=Controcampus |quote=Il programma dell'incontro prevede i saluti della direttrice dell'istituto, Donata Levi, e del vice direttore, Pietro Corvaja, che presenterà la Scuola. |date=12 March 2014 |accessdate=13 January 2020}}</ref><ref name="Instituto-Veneto"/><ref name="Scuola-Udine">{{cite web|url=https://scuolasuperiore.uniud.it/la-scuola/organi-direttivi |lang=it |title=Organi direttivi |publisher=School of Excellence of the University of Udine |accessdate=13 January 2020}}</ref>

==Research==
Corvaja and Zannier gave a new proof of [[Siegel's theorem on integral points]] in 2002 by using a new method based on the [[subspace theorem]].<ref>Corvaja, P. and Zannier, U. "A subspace theorem approach to integral points on curves", Compte Rendu Acad. Sci., 334, 2002, pp. 267–271 {{doi|10.1016/S1631-073X(02)02240-9}}</ref>

==Awards==
Corvaja was inducted into the [[Istituto Veneto di Scienze, Lettere ed Arti]] on 26 May 2016.<ref name="Instituto-Veneto"/>

==Selected publications==
* with J. Noguchi: ''A new unicity theorem and Erdős' problem for polarized semi-abelian varieties'', Math. Ann., vol. 353, no. 2 (2012), pp. 439–464.
* with U. Zannier: ''A subspace theorem approach to integral points on curves'', Compte Rendu Acad. Sci., vol. 334, 2002, pp. 267–271 {{doi|10.1016/S1631-073X(02)02240-9}}
* with U. Zannier: '' Finiteness of Integral Values for the Ratio of Two Linear Recurrences'', Inventiones Mathematicae, vol. 149, 2002, pp. 431–451. {{doi|10.1007/s002220200221}}
* with U. Zannier: ''On Integral Points on Surfaces'', Annals of Mathematics, Vol. 160, 2004, pp. 705–726. [https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0206100v1 arXiv preprint]
* with U. Zannier: ''On the rational approximations to the powers of an algebraic number: solution of two problems of Mahler and Mendès France'', Acta Mathematica, vol. 193, no. 2, 2004, pp. 175–191. {{doi|10.1007/BF02392563}}
* with U. Zannier: ''Some cases of Vojta's conjecture on integral points over function fields'', Journal of Algebraic Geometry, vol. 17, 2008, pp. 295–333. [https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0512074 arXiv preprint]
